items.title: 63520_Ernie Fields oral history interview
items.q: Chambers said no, I know Ernie Fields, but I never was in his band, I just know him indirectly. Maybe I met him, I don't know.

ctx.x: Yeah, Portland, Oregon, and of course I didn't know anything, I forgot about Dewey, and I was touring the west coast, the northwest, and Pops McElroy, who brought names in, he'd have Lunceford, Duke and all, but anyway, an area booker I got connected with, and they set a tour for me through there.
